means: Flat areas of colour with hard-edged shadow, imitating the ink-and-paint animation cels this style is named after. The shadow is a SHAPE with a border, not a gradient.
does: Replaces soft gradient shading on skin and cloth with two or three flat tones separated by a crisp terminator line, and strengthens outlines.
reach_for_it: when the frame should read as animation rather than as an illustration or a photograph
used_in: the house style tag of every film in this project
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
